The only crossing linkage is the section-level heading metadata (best_work section) and the authority=user tag on the avoid_errors heading, which are seeded below.

The 'Avoid overstepping' and 'Be creative' subsections (L3239-3383) are cohesive units about overstepping and creativity. The only crossing linkage is the best_work section heading metadata and the authority tags on the avoid_overstepping and be_creative headings, which are seeded below.

The 'Support programmatic use' subsection (L3384-3501) is a self-contained unit about interactive vs. programmatic behavior. The only crossing linkage is the best_work section heading metadata and the authority=guideline tag on the support_programmatic_use heading, which are seeded below.
